description: Investissements de SNCF Mobilités (en milliards d'euros) depuis 1997 is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Investissements SNCF Mobilités (en milliards d'euros) tous financements confondus (y compris les financements par des tiers comme les Régions) dont la part de financement propre de SNCF depuis 1997. Ces investissements concernent les actifs immobilisés au bilan (inversement, pas les dépenses quotidiennes). Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Informations institutionnelles et financières. Its keywords are Investissement, Investissement net, SNCF Mobilités, Direction Stratégie Finances. The portal shows 2019-09-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
